news.title: Nieuwe lichting maritieme startups en scale-ups voor PortXL
PortXL presents its new cohort of maritime startups and scale-ups

summary: PortXL is the world port accelerator - innovation driver in the green energy, logistics, maritime & process industry., founded in 2015. Type: startup / scale-up. About 32 employees (LinkedIn page). Not found in the IND sponsor register. 100% of its 2 jobs here don't ask for Dutch.
sources: IND public register (work / highly skilled migrants), fetched 2026-10-06, https://ind.nl/en/public-register-recognised-sponsors/public-register-regular-labour-and-highly-skilled-migrants

LinkedIn page (existing data, collected via Apify; LinkedIn terms forbid scraping)

culture.text: A small team (about 32 on LinkedIn) at the Innovation Dock on RDM Campus in Rotterdam, matching startups with the maritime industry.
Staff mostly studied at Erasmus University Rotterdam, RSM, TU Delft, TIAS or Nyenrode, in business and economics.

open.text: Not listed as an IND recognised visa sponsor.
Scouts and accelerates new technologies from around the world.

growth.text: Presented a new cohort of maritime startups and scale-ups.

worth_knowing.text: Focuses on making the maritime sector climate-positive, with work across energy, logistics and ports.
